name: Pheedback
description:
Pheedback replaces static feedback forms with AI-powered conversational surveys — "pheedbacks" that ask intelligent follow-ups and adapt to each respondent, surfacing the "why" behind the answers instead of just the numbers.

With the Pheedback connector, you can create surveys and work with your results without leaving Claude:

Create pheedbacks by describing what you want to learn in plain language. Pheedback turns your goal into a conversational survey with sensible questions and follow-up logic.
List your pheedbacks across your organizations to see what's active and find the one you need.
List organizations you belong to, so you're always working in the right workspace.
Get responses for any pheedback and bring them into Claude — where you can summarize them, pull out themes, compare answers, and turn raw feedback into a clear takeaway just by asking.

The analysis happens in the conversation. Because pheedbacks collect richer open-ended feedback than checkbox forms, and because you can interrogate the responses the way you'd interrogate any dataset — ask a question, get an answer, ask the next — you go from feedback to insight without switching tools or exporting anything.

Typical uses: customer and product feedback, employee and team pulse checks, event and post-purchase follow-ups, and user research.

Connect your Pheedback account once and your organizations, pheedbacks, and responses are available to Claude directly.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Pheedback to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Pheedback to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.pheedback.co/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Pheedback MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Pheedback provides these MCP tools: create_pheedback, get_pheedback_responses, list_organizations, and list_pheedbacks.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Pheedback?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Pheedback in communication on the Manufact MCP catalog include AgentLine: Phone Numbers for AI Agents, JooVoice, OpenMail, Granola, and Fleet Connected Apps.
Pheedback requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Pheedback is developed by Pheedback. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
